_comment: Phase 5.4 golden set — 20 grounded question -> expected-page pairs drawn from the MaskFall fall-detection thesis (course 'ai'). Expected pages are the PHYSICAL PDF pages where the answer text sits (what the ingester stores as chunk page_number). The harness counts a hit when any retrieved chunk's page is within PAGE_TOLERANCE of an expected page. Tied to one document in the dev DB and needs Cohere + Supabase, so the harness is guarded by -Deval.golden=true and never runs in CI.

questions.question: Which dataset is used to train and evaluate the fall detection models?
Which camera view of the UP-Fall dataset does this work use?
What accuracy did Yu et al. report for their TCNTE model?
What sliding-window length and step size are used to build windows?
What is the frame-level class imbalance ratio in the corpus?
What is the window-level class imbalance ratio after the vote?
What voting rule turns per-frame labels into a single window label?
What is the maximum gap length filled by the cubic spline (MAX_GAP)?
questions.note: MAX_GAP = 6 frames; longer gaps use a linear bridge

questions.question: Which pose estimator and tracker are used to extract skeletons?
How many body joints are kept and what is the per-frame coordinate vector size?
What loss function is used and with what parameters?
How many fall windows and total windows does the dataset contain?
What file-level accuracy range do the models reach under the honest protocol?
By how many percentage points do the honest results fall below the source papers?
Which model achieves the best file-level accuracy?
Is occlusion augmentation or masked pretraining the more effective robustness mechanism?
questions.note: augmentation; pretraining adds nothing on top of it

questions.question: How long does each model take to classify a one-second window on a CPU?
What is the unseen block-occlusion corruption used in the stress test?
questions.note: masks a joint for a contiguous span of at least nine frames

questions.question: Which fall activity is the hardest to detect, and why?
questions.note: sideward fall (A4); less vertical displacement from a frontal camera

questions.question: What does the thesis blame for the source papers' inflated accuracy figures?
questions.note: window-level leakage from splitting overlapping windows
